items.cue: 👫 Ben is a friend of mine.
options: I know him very well.
I've known him very well.

items.cue: 🏡 I like your house.
options: How long do you live here?
How long have you lived here?

items.cue: ☔ Take an umbrella if you go out now.
options: It's raining.
It's been raining.
The weather is awful since I arrived here.
The weather has been awful since I arrived here.

items.cue: ⏰ I’m sorry I’m late.
options: Are you waiting long?
Have you been waiting long?

items.cue: 📦 We’ve moved house.
options: We're living in New Street now.
We've been living in New Street now.

items.cue: 🤝 I met Maria only recently.
options: I don't know her very long.
I haven't known her very long.

items.cue: 🇩🇪 Lisa is in Germany at the moment.
options: She's there on a business trip.
She's been there on a business trip.

items.cue: 🚲 That’s a very old bike.
options: How long do you have it?
How long have you had it?

items.cue: 🤒 I’m not feeling good.
options: I'm feeling ill all day.
I've been feeling ill all day.

exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions of the situations and write questions using the words in brackets.

items.cue: 🏥 A friend tells you that Paul is in hospital. You ask your friend:
answers: How long has Paul been in hospital?

items.cue: 👭 Jane is a good friend of Katherine’s. You ask Jane:
answers: How long have you known Katherine?

items.cue: 🇦🇺 Your friend’s sister went to Australia some time ago and she’s still there. You ask your friend:
answers: How long has your sister been in Australia?

items.cue: 👩‍🏫 You meet a woman who teaches English. You ask her:
answers: How long have you been teaching English?
How long have you taught English?

items.cue: 🧥 Tom wears the same jacket all the time. It’s very old. You ask him:
answers: How long have you had that jacket?

items.cue: ✈️ Joe works at the airport now. You ask a friend about him:
answers: How long has Joe been working at the airport?
How long has Joe worked at the airport?

items.cue: 🛫 On a plane you meet a woman who lives in Chicago. You ask her:
answers: Have you always lived in Chicago?

exercises.instruction: Complete B's answers to A's questions.

items.cue: 💬 A: Paul is in hospital, isn’t he?
parts: Yes, he’s been in hospital since Monday.

items.cue: 💬 A: Do you see Lisa very often?
parts: No, I haven’t seen her for three months.
